notes: KONA 5 is an internal PCIe 3.0 x8 capture/playback card for a host computer, not a standalone rack unit (rackUnits omitted). Data drawn from AJA's own product page (aja.com/products/kona-5), which is authoritative for connection types, counts, and versions (4x bidirectional 12G-SDI via HD-BNC; 1x full-size HDMI 2.0 out; analog reference in via HD-BNC; breakout cable with RS-422 9-pin, 2x LTC BNC, and 8ch AES/EBU via 4x BNC each direction; 6-pin ATX/PCIe power connector, Molex 45559-0002). Confidence set to medium because: (1) individual SDI port numbering (SDI1-4) and AES/EBU BNC connector labels are not explicitly printed on the spec page (inferred standard AJA convention), (2) the power connector is a 6-pin PCIe/ATX mini-fit connector with no exact match in the provided connector enum — approximated as dc-barrel, and (3) category/type ("converter"/"Converter") is the closest fit in the given taxonomy but the device is more precisely a video capture/playback I/O card used with editing/broadcast software, not a pure format converter. HDMI is output-only (no HDMI input) per AJA's spec sheet.

ports.name: SDI 1
ports.note: HD-BNC on card bracket; independently configurable in or out, supports 12G/6G/3G/1.5G-SDI

ports.name: HDMI Out
ports.note: Full-size HDMI 2.0, supports 4K/UltraHD HFR and HDR monitoring/output

ports.name: Ref In
ports.note: HD-BNC at PCIe bracket; analog reference (black burst, composite sync, or HD tri-level sync), 75-ohm terminating

ports.name: LTC In
ports.note: On breakout cable; card also has an additional LTC input via 2-pin internal header and via HD-BNC at the PCIe bracket

ports.name: RS-422
ports.note: 9-pin D-connector on breakout cable, Sony 9-pin protocol machine control

ports.name: AES/EBU In 1
ports.note: One of 4x BNC on breakout cable carrying 8 channels of AES/EBU input (2 channels per BNC pair); individual connector labels not confirmed from published spec

ports.name: AES/EBU Out 1
ports.note: One of 4x BNC on breakout cable carrying 8 channels of AES/EBU output (2 channels per BNC pair)

ports.name: PCIe Power
ports.note: Actual connector is a 6-pin ATX/PCIe internal power connector (Molex p/n 45559-0002, mini-fit Jr style), not a barrel jack — no exact match in the given connector list, so dc-barrel is used as the closest DC-power analog. Draws 28W typical / 35W max. Card also seats in an 8-lane PCIe 3.0 slot.
